settings.heading: How long does an order take?
settings.text: If it is in the current firing, three working days. If it is not, it waits for the next kiln — we fire in June and December.

settings.heading: Can I change or cancel an order?
settings.text: Any time before it is packed, in full. Nothing is made to order, so nothing is wasted either way.

settings.heading: What happens when a firing sells out?
settings.text: It is not repeated. The forms come back in the next kiln, but the glaze on them will not be the same, and that is the point.

settings.heading: Do you take commissions?
settings.text: Dinner services, once or twice a year. Write with the count and the form; a full service takes two firings, so a year.

settings.heading: Ordering
settings.intro: Everything here is answered by a person if you would rather ask.

settings.heading: What is the clay?
settings.text: Two stoneware bodies from the same pit outside São Thomé, blended wet in the yard and rested a month before anything is thrown.

settings.heading: What are the four glazes?
settings.text: Ash, oatmeal, iron black and a clear used only inside cups. All four are mixed here from raw materials, and the recipes are published in the journal.

settings.heading: Why do two of the same piece look different?
settings.text: Because they were in different parts of a wood kiln. Thirty-six hours of flame does not treat both sides alike.

settings.heading: Is the glaze food safe?
settings.text: All four, yes, and tested. Iron black is not for the microwave — the iron in it heats — and that is the only restriction.

settings.heading: Can these go in the dishwasher?
settings.text: Yes, all four glazes, every day. Stoneware fired to 1,280°C is harder than the machine.

settings.heading: The glaze has crazed. Is that a fault?
settings.text: No. Fine lines in an ash glaze are normal and do not go through the body. If a piece leaks, that is a fault, and we replace it.

settings.heading: Something broke. What now?
settings.text: Write with the number cut into the foot. Breakages in the first year are replaced from the next firing, and after that we do what we can.

settings.heading: How is an order sent?
settings.text: Straw-packed by hand, double-boxed, insured and signed for. Tracking arrives the morning it leaves Tiradentes.

settings.heading: Do you ship outside Brazil?
settings.text: Yes. Duties and import taxes are the customer’s, and we declare the full value — we will not under-declare a parcel.

settings.heading: What if it arrives broken?
settings.text: Photograph the box and the piece and write the same day. We replace it from the next firing, and we do not ask you to post the pieces back.

settings.heading: Still unanswered?
settings.intro: A person reads every message. We reply within two working days.
